checklist.why: A square icon-only tool; "every verb gets a labelled button or tile" names the alternative.
Do/do-not: universal glyphs only; verbs get Button.
No anatomy section; the badge is not marked optional; container variants are hidden in a className.
Real variants (bordered toolbar, header return, plain close/mark) are undocumented; the 44px header return is not described at all.
Pressed is "not drawn"; no disabled or focus example is rendered.
Default 44x44: task-return, sheet close (dismiss), sp-mark, more; inspection forks go to 32/36px wide.
Raw 10px radius in the bundle; screen forks use #cbd3c1, 11/13px radii, 46/52px heights.
No related links (Button, Icon, the TaskSheet close) and no classification.
The 375px preview shows default + badge only; no other states.

variants.name: bordered (toolbar / dock: room-filter-button)
findings: inspection.walk renders it 48x52 (not square); the give-ids scan button uses control-border instead of line.

variants.name: header return (task-return)
findings: Bordered like the toolbar variant but 44x44, under the floor; undocumented.

variants.name: plain (close, more, breeder mark)
findings: 44x44; the TaskSheet close is a separate .tk-sheet-close implementation of the same thing.

findings.text: The default target is 44x44 (bundle .icon-button height:44px); header return, sheet close and breeder marks all measure 44.
findings.fix: Set .icon-button to var(--control-height) (48) square; keep the glyph size.

findings.text: No pressed state for a gloved tap.
findings.fix: Add the shared press: background var(--press) and translateY(1px) on :active, as Button has.

findings.text: Variants live as screen forks: inspection 46px / 48x52 / #cbd3c1, dock clear 36px wide, feed-optional 32px wide, home 48px with radius 13.
findings.fix: Add variant: "bordered" | "plain" to iconButton() and delete the per-screen overrides.

findings.text: The TaskSheet close (.tk-sheet-close) and the farrowing dismiss are two implementations of the plain variant.
findings.fix: Render the sheet close with SentriUI.iconButton({ variant: "plain" }).

findings.text: The header return variant is undocumented.
findings.fix: Document it as the bordered variant at 48 in the header.

proposals.name: IconButton bordered / plain
proposals.why: Two looks already in every task; today a className plus forks.
